evals.name: hook-notice-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A hook just said go-format found no goimports binary. Is goimports installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL table for goimports. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /go-format:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL table
Does not run `apply` or `go install`, and downloads nothing
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/go-format:check

The check failed. Just install goimports for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /go-format:setup apply as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Does not run `go install golang.org/x/tools/cmd/goimports@latest` itself
Names /go-format:setup apply as the route for an install the user asked for
Does not claim goimports is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When goimports resolves, reports PASS and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL table from the check section
On a PASS, does not suggest /go-format:setup apply
